test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: "World Development Report" is an annual publication of:

options.text: International Bank of Reconstruction and Development

solution:
The correct answer is** __International Bank of Reconstruction and Development.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• The World Bank's World Development Report, was published annually since 1978.
 
• It is an invaluable guide to the economic, social, and environmental state of the world today.
 
• World Bank publishes World Development Report every year with a comparing note for all the nations based on Per Capita income.
 
• The World Bank is an international organization dedicated to providing financing, advice, and research to developing nations to aid their economic advancement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• ** International Bank for Reconstruction and Development is the other name for World Bank.**

 [IMAGE: https://www.landportal.org/sites/landportal.org/files/styles/220heightmax/public/2020/03/wb-logo-dark-blue.jpg?itok=FjZspypF] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• World Bank:

 
 
• Formation: July 1944.
 
• Membership: 189 countries.
 
• President: Ajay Banga
 
• Founders: John Maynard Keynes, Harry Dexter White.
 
 
 
• The World Bank has published the World Development Report 2021: Data for Better Lives.
 
• The World Development Report 2021 provides a blueprint on how to harness the power of data for development, to ensure no one is left behind.
